title: Rama vs. the perfect loophole

verse.sanskrit:
सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्यं पद्मा श्रिता सदा ।
सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम् ॥
verse.iast:
satyam eveśvaro loke satyaṃ padmā śritā sadā |
satyamūlāni sarvāṇi satyān nāsti paraṃ padam ||
verse.translation: Truth alone is the lord in this world; prosperity always rests on truth. Truth is the root of everything; there is nothing higher than truth.

beats.title: someone hands you the perfect LOOPHOLE
beats.vo: Someone hands you the perfect loophole. Totally legal. Nobody would ever blame you.

beats.title: PLOT TWIST
beats.vo: Rama is in the forest, keeping his promise. His father has passed. Bharata brings the whole court to take him home. Then a priest named Jabali drops the cheat code.
Your father is gone, he says. You owe him nothing now. Take the kingdom Bharata is offering, go home, and enjoy the royal life.
Anyone else: say less, I'm packing. Rama: sounds right, but it's wrong. Not for greed, not for confusion, will I break the bridge of truth.
Truth alone is the lord in this world. Everything grows from truth. Nothing is higher than truth.
A loophole can win you a throne. Only truth makes you someone worth putting on it.
Next time the group chat says nobody will ever know: you will know. That's enough.

beats.title: Day 8 of learning from Rama
beats.vo: Day eight of learning from Rama. Send this to the friend who always finds the loophole.

caption:
POV: someone hands you the perfect loophole 🕳️

With his father gone, the priest Jabali told Rama the promise was over: take the throne, go home, enjoy. Rama said it sounded right but was wrong, and stayed in the forest.

“सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्यं पद्मा श्रिता सदा । सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम् ॥”
Valmiki Ramayana, Ayodhya Kanda 109.13

Truth is the root. Day 8 of learning from Rama.
